sources.title: donedynamics/Qwen3.8-27B-heretic-MLX-6bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The base model is an abliterated ("heretic") derivative of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B: its refusal behaviour has been surgically removed, so it will answer prompts a safety-tuned model would decline.

sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B arrives with Day 0 support on AMD Ryzen™ AI processors and Radeon™ graphics cards. Run the latest Qwen model locally with LM Studio on supported AMD hardware. Build and ship local AI applications with Lemonade and first-class AMD inference support.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable reasoning and a native 262K-token context window.
